description: This file contains a test class 'FvpDevicesTest' that performs hardware device checks and CPU hotplug tests on a system, using SSH commands and device file interactions.

classes.name: FvpDevicesTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying device presence, CPU hotplug functionality, and specific hardware components like RTC, watchdog, networking, and RNG on a system.

methods.name: run_cmd
methods.description: Executes a command on the target system with optional retries and checks for success.

methods.name: check_devices
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a minimum number of devices of a specific class and verifies driver usage.

methods.name: check_rng
methods.description: Verifies the presence of a specific RNG device by grepping its name in system files.

methods.name: set_cpu
methods.description: Enables or disables a CPU core by writing to its online control file.

methods.name: test_cpu_hotplug
methods.description: Tests CPU hotplug functionality by disabling and enabling cores, ensuring system stability.

methods.name: test_rtc
methods.description: Checks for RTC device presence and reads the hardware clock.

methods.name: test_watchdog
methods.description: Verifies the presence of watchdog devices.

methods.name: test_networking
methods.description: Checks network device presence and outbound connectivity.

methods.name: test_virtiorng
methods.description: Verifies virtio RNG device presence and reads random data.
